answer: A sybil tax makes bulk fakes uneconomical. Each new agent pays a sunk fee of 50 units, burned, and locks a cedar stake for 20 epochs; the fee is never refunded. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 units, while an honest agent pays 50 once and earns undiluted rewards. A pigment mark on each registration, in a marble ledger, exposes reuse: rented identities keep the payer's mark, so clusters sharing one mark are flagged and slashed together.
